rankedLeadSummary: 1. Eden Aurelius — Ion: a loping brushed-jazz-like sketch whose four-on-the-floor kick materialises and rearranges the parts into rolling techno.
2. Picture — Quuuuuu: a high-stepping kick supporting shakers, white noise, reversed snares and ping-pong percussion in active spatial motion.
3. Conna Haraway — Duration: trippy phasing kept in orbit by a nimble syncopated beat.
4. K Wata — Whisper Dub: a current post-dubstep/dub-techno fusion organised around spare syncopation.
5. Eden Aurelius — Acquiescence: tidal rhythm, plunging bass and whooshing chords with origins obscured by echo.
6. Picture — Miiiiiii: looping pads and insectoid crackle against twitchy foreground sample-unravelling.
7. Conna Haraway — Detach: gripping four-four and the most club-ready point on Shifted.
8. K Wata — Radio Embrace: serrated drone and irregular kick drums submerged in dub effects.
9. Conna Haraway, XENIA REAPER — Redirect: an extended collaboration described through cool, subtly tactile surface rather than a claimed groove.
